blocks.en: In general, one cannot define the product of two generalized functions $f(\bm{x})$ and $g(\bm{x})$. However, it is always possible to multiply two generalized functions depending on different variables. That is, if $f\in\mathcal{D}^{\prime}(\mathbb{R}^p)$ and $g\in\mathcal{D}^{\prime}(\mathbb{R}^q)$, then $f(\bm{x})g(\bm{y})$ can be defined as a distribution on $\mathbb{R}^{p+q}$.
blocks.zh: 一般不能定义两个广义函数 $f(\bm{x})$ 和 $g(\bm{x})$ 的乘积. 然而, 总可以将依赖于不同变量的两个广义函数相乘. 即若 $f\in\mathcal{D}^{\prime}(\mathbb{R}^p)$ 且 $g\in\mathcal{D}^{\prime}(\mathbb{R}^q)$, 则可以将 $f(\bm{x})g(\bm{y})$ 定义为 $\mathbb{R}^{p+q}$ 上的分布.
